
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/swizard/p/19304971" title="发布于 2025-12-04 08:57">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Nginx 反向代理实战指南：从动态解析到 WebSocket</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span data-markdown-start-index="133">在现代微服务架构中，Nginx 不仅仅是一个静态资源服务器，更充当着核心网关的角色。它负责流量的路由、负载均衡以及协议的转换。本文将结合具体的生产环境配置实例，详细解析 Nginx 在处理 API 转发、路径重写（Rewrite）以及长连接代理时的最佳实践。</span></p>
<h2><span data-markdown-start-index="266">1. 核心前置：动态域名解析与 Resolver</span></h2>
<p><span data-markdown-start-index="291">在容器化环境（如 Docker、Kubernetes）中，服务实例的 IP 地址通常是动态变化的。如果在 Nginx 配置文件中直接使用&nbsp;<code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="441">proxy_pass http://backend:8080;</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="473">，Nginx 仅会在启动或重载配置时解析一次域名。若后端服务重启IP变更，Nginx 将无法感知，导致“Host not found”或连接超时。</span></span></p>
<p><span data-markdown-start-index="467">为了解决这个问题，通常采用&nbsp;“变量定义 Upstream”<span data-markdown-start-index="538">&nbsp;的技巧，强制 Nginx 在每次请求时<span data-markdown-start-index="586">重新解析域名。但这要求必须显式配置&nbsp;<code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="639">resolver</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="648">&nbsp;指令。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h3><span data-markdown-start-index="561">关键配置示例</span></h3>
<div class="sticky-container">&nbsp;
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">http {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    # 定义 DNS 解析器
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     # Docker 环境通常使用 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">127.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.11</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     # 公网环境可使用 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.8</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.8</span> 或 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.1</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.1</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     resolver <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">127.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.11</span> valid=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">30s; 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    # 解析超时时间
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    resolver_timeout 5s;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    server {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>         listen <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        # ... 后续 location 配置
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
　　</div>
<pre><code class="language-nginx"></code></pre>
<p>技术解析：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="819">resolver</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="830">: 指定 Nginx 用于解析 upstream 域名的 DNS 服务器地址。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="876">valid</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="884">: 设置 DNS 缓存的有效期。在动态性极高的环境中，适当降低该值（如 10s-30s）可以更敏捷地感知后端变化。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2><span data-markdown-start-index="949">2. 场景演练：常规 API 代理与路径剥离</span></h2>
<p><span data-markdown-start-index="972">最常见的反代需求是将前端的特定前缀请求（如&nbsp;<code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="1037">/prd-api/</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="1047">）转发给后端服务，但在转发时需要去除该前缀。</span></span></p>
<h3><span data-markdown-start-index="1032">配置实例：/prd-api/</span></h3>
<div class="sticky-container">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="code-block-header"><span class="language">nginx</span></div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> location /prd-api/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>     # <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 使用变量定义 Upstream，配合 resolver 实现动态解析
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     set $backend_upstream http:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">backend:8080;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     # <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>. 路径重写：剥离 /prd-api/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 前缀
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     # 请求 /prd-api/users -&gt; /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">users
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     rewrite ^/prd-api/(.*)$ /$<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> break;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     # <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 转发请求
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    proxy_pass $backend_upstream;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     # <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 传递标准 Header，确保后端获取真实客户端信息
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    proxy_set_header Host $host;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>     proxy_set_header X-Real-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">IP $remote_addr;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>     proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>     proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Proto $scheme;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>技术解析：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="1555">set $backend_upstream</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="1579">: 结合前文提到的&nbsp;<code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="1604">resolver</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="1613">，此写法确保了 Nginx 在运行时动态解析&nbsp;<code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="1667">backend</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="1675">&nbsp;域名，增强了服务的容错性。</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="1652">rewrite ... break</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="1672">: 正则表达式&nbsp;<code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="1691">^/prd-api/(.*)$</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="1707">&nbsp;捕获了 URI 后半部分，并重组为&nbsp;<code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="1751">/$1</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="1755">。<code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="1759">break</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="1765">&nbsp;标志位至关重要，它指示 Nginx 停止当前 rewrite 阶段的匹配，直接使用修改后的 URI 进行&nbsp;<code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="1882">proxy_pass</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="1893">&nbsp;处理。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2><span data-markdown-start-index="1807">3. 场景演练：API 路径映射</span></h2>
<p><span data-markdown-start-index="1824">在某些复杂场景下，前端暴露的路由结构与后端服务的实际路由结构并不一致，这时需要进行路径映射替换，而不仅仅是剥离前缀。</span></p>
<h3><span data-markdown-start-index="1887">配置实例：/ai-api/</span></h3>
<div class="sticky-container">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="code-block-header"><span class="language">nginx</span></div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> # Proxy <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AI analysis API
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> location /ai-api/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     set $analysis_upstream http:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">analysis:8199;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     # 路径映射：将 /ai-api/xxxx 映射为 /api/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">xxxx
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     rewrite ^/ai-api/(.*)$ /api/$<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> break;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    proxy_pass $analysis_upstream;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    proxy_set_header Host $host;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     proxy_set_header X-Real-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">IP $remote_addr;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>     proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Proto $scheme;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>技术解析：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><span data-markdown-start-index="2325">该配置实现了业务逻辑的解耦。对外暴露的是业务相关的&nbsp;<code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="2402">/ai-api/</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="2411">，而对内则路由到了通用分析服务的&nbsp;<code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="2461">/api/</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="2467">&nbsp;接口。这种屏蔽内部实现细节的做法增强了系统的安全性与灵活性。</span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2><span data-markdown-start-index="2424">4. 场景演练：WebSocket 协议升级</span></h2>
<p><span data-markdown-start-index="2447">WebSocket 是一种全双工通信协议，常用于实时消息推送。由于 Nginx 默认使用 HTTP/1.0 连接上游，且不传递 Upgrade 头部，直接反代会导致 WebSocket 握手失败。</span></p>
<h3><span data-markdown-start-index="2550">配置实例：/ws-api/</span></h3>
<div class="sticky-container">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="code-block-header"><span class="language">nginx</span></div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> # Proxy <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> WebSocket (frontend -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PC Backend)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> location /ws-api/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     set $backend_upstream http:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">backend:8081;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     # 复杂的路径重写：前端 /ws-api/ -&gt; 后端 /websocket/server/
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     rewrite ^/ws-api/(.*)$ /websocket/server/$<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> break;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    proxy_pass $backend_upstream;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     # --- WebSocket 核心配置 Start ---
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     # <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>. 必须使用 HTTP/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.1</span>，HTTP/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.0</span> 不支持 Keep-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">alive 和 Upgrade
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>     proxy_http_version <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>     # <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 传递 Upgrade 头部，告知后端进行协议升级
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>     proxy_set_header Connection <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">upgrade</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>     # --- WebSocket 核心配置 End ---
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    proxy_set_header Host $host;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span>     proxy_set_header X-Real-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">IP $remote_addr;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>     proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span>     proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Proto $scheme;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    # 建议：适当延长读取超时时间，避免长连接因空闲被切断
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>技术解析：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="3375">proxy_http_version 1.1</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="3400">: 这是 WebSocket 反代的基石。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Header 传递<span data-markdown-start-index="3442">:&nbsp;<code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="3445">$http_upgrade</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="3459">&nbsp;变量包含了客户端请求中的 Upgrade 头部值（通常为 "websocket"）。显式设置&nbsp;<code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="3558">Connection "upgrade"</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="3579">&nbsp;是完成握手协议升级的必要步骤。</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>超时设置<span data-markdown-start-index="3561">: WebSocket 通常保持长连接，默认的 60 秒超时往往不足，建议根据业务需求调整&nbsp;<code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="3666">proxy_read_timeout</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="3685">。</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2><span data-markdown-start-index="3628">总结</span></h2>
<p><span data-markdown-start-index="3631">通过合理配置&nbsp;<code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="3651">resolver</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="3660">&nbsp;实现动态解析，利用&nbsp;<code class="inline-code"><span data-markdown-start-index="3690">rewrite</span></code><span data-markdown-start-index="3698">&nbsp;处理灵活的路径路由，以及正确设置 Header 支持 WebSocket 协议，Nginx 能够高效地支撑起复杂的微服务流量转发需求。在实际生产部署中，保持配置的模块化与可读性同样至关重要。</span></span></span></p>
</div>
<div class="clear"></div>
